title: Ask the Iron
summary: Tamsin left her aunt her notes on asking the iron instead of telling it. Dagny will lend them to a mage of yours: by the Assay's furnace, under the Yards, where everything's hot enough to listen.

steps.journal: The Assay Yards' second floor, the cellars: hold eight waves.

ready: Eight waves under the Yards. Give Tamsin's notes back to Dagny at the Slag & Bellows in Ashgate.
done: Your mages ask the weather now. Tamsin's notes say it's the same as iron, only wetter.
